column1: # reference/runtime-manifest.tsv — runtime manifest for crewboss box runtime (issue #62)
# Built from snapshot: _box-snapshot/cbnet/ (67 files, 2026-06-11, operator delivery #61)
#   CI verifies this manifest against repo files so it never goes stale silently.
#   Doctor on box compares deployed files against this manifest.
#   canonical       — repo already has the file at repo_path with this sha256;
#                     CI gate: file must exist + sha must match (test 3 sha-lock)
#   pending-backport — box has the file; repo_path = planned canonical target
#                      CI does NOT verify the file (it doesn't exist at repo_path yet)
#                        kill_switch at run/kill_switch; used in production)
#   Launcher tests (reference/tests/launcher-*.test.sh) continue to run against the LEGACY
#   version until migration. DO NOT DELETE the legacy file — tests depend on it.
#   Behavioral gate discriminator for charter→main: fires a live jailed --agent session,
#   greps for 'crewboss BLOCK' marker in gate output to discriminate correct gate wiring.
#   Backported from box snapshot to reference/runtime/ by #65 (pkill-f → pid-file fix applied);
